items: 【COMPREHENSIVE HOME TOOL KIT】 The 120 pcs house tool kit contains multiple hand tools and a 20V cordless power drill. This household tool set is suitable for DIY Projects, home repair and maintenance jobs, drilling wood and metal, replacing screws, turning nuts, stripping wire, and other basic repair jobs around your house.

【20V POWER DRILL & 2.0 Ah BATTERY】 The 20V cordless power drill is powered by a 2.0Ah high-capacity lithium ion battery for longer working hours. A 2.5-hour charger is included. The electric drill features 3/8" (10mm) keyless chuck and 25+1 torque setting with max 266 in-lbs torque. It holds the bits tight without falling off. 2 variable speed (0-350RPM and 0-1300RPM) allows you to easily control the drilling speed.

【MULTI-PURPOSE HOUSEHOLD TOOLS】 This tool set for home contains the most useful hand tools for repairing or maintaining precision electronics projects and hardware upgrades. Claw hammer, hand saw, plumbing pliers,long-nose pliers, wrench, tape measure (10ft) , paper cutter, sockets, screwdriver and screwdriver bits. Perfect tool sets for homeowners: tightening screws, assembling furniture, putting up curtain rods and so on.

【WELL MANUFACTURED TOOLS】 The household tool set includes hand tools that are manufactured from steel alloy, chrome vanadium for strength and durability. The non-slip handles provides comfort grip. Tools are compact in size and light in weight so that you can work with less fatigue.
【EASY TO CARRY】 All the hand tools are packed in a sturdy, compact carrying case for storage and portability. Each tool fits snugly into its respective place to prevent moving around and scraping.
